source_document_header: 2026-27 NBA REGULAR SEASON SCHEDULE AS OF AUGUST 13, 2026 | SUBJECT TO CHANGE

window.rule: requested maximum horizon of 3 days from the observation time; games tipping off on or after 2026-11-20T16:00:00Z are outside the window

basis.away_home_rule: The schedule PDF prints two team cells and, on rows 253-259, prints no 'at' or 'vs' token between them. The away/home reading is therefore taken from the official injury report's matchup code (AWAY@HOME) when that report prints the same game, from the printed 'at' token where one exists (rows 260-273), and is otherwise corroborated by the games-page slug (away-vs-home) and left flagged.

games_page_corroboration.rule: the schedule extraction published on main is the file of record; the games-page fields are added alongside it, and no printed value in it is overwritten

extraction_notes: The PDF text carries the column header "LOCAL | ET" (read 2026-11-17 from chunks 1 and 2 of the PDF text). The first time column (tip_et_col1) is the local tip time at the home venue and the second (tip_et_col2) is Eastern time. Checked for all 21 window rows: the Eastern value equals the home venue's local time converted to ET in 21 of 21 rows. This is a consistency check against venue time zones, not a statement taken from the document; both values stay verbatim.

The extracted PDF text prints no "at" token on rows 253-259 (11/17 to the first two 11/18 rows) while rows 260 onward print "at"; re-confirmed on the 2026-11-17 fetch (matches the P7-02/AN-02 finding). Away/home order on rows 253-259 is therefore shown only where an independent source agrees: the 11/17 10:30 AM injury report prints matchup codes for all five 11/17 games and all twelve 11/18 games, and every one of the 21 window games has a games-page slug of the form away-vs-home. Rows 270-273 (11/19) are not listed by this report and rely on the printed 'at' token plus the slug; all four carry both.

Four tips disagree between the August schedule PDF and the nba.com games pages: rows 256 (schedule 10:00 PM ET / games page 11:00 PM ET), 257 (11:00 / 10:30), 266 (9:00 / 9:30) and 267 (9:30 / 8:00). Both printed values are kept on the row; neither is overwritten (extends flags AN-02 and P9-04).
Game ids follow the observed games-page pattern 00226002 + (schedule row - 200); checked on all 21 slugs read on 2026-11-17.
No line, probability, pick or model output is present in this file.
